name: 02-reference-with-evidence
description: Same idea with quantified paid evidence: both demand scores must rise above the no-evidence ceilings.

input.idea: Marketplace where local home cooks sell fresh homemade meals to nearby busy professionals for pickup or delivery
input.targetUser: Busy professionals who regularly order food
input.goal: Test demand, repeat purchases, and marketplace viability
input.constraints: $2,000 budget, solo founder, one neighborhood, food regulations
input.evidence: Interviewed 12 professionals in the neighborhood; 9 pre-paid $15 for a first meal and 6 cooks signed up.
